So fragment B further splits into ClCCl (dichloromethane?) and FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1 (a simpler side chain lacking the chlorophenyl). Good.

Now we need to apply template 1914395 to the remaining fragments: we have fragment A unchanged, fragment B' = FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1, and also maybe fragment from B split: ClCCl.

We need to apply 1914395 to each of these? Probably to fragment A and maybe to fragment B' to get precursors.
